correctness.rationale: The cover has n vertices and two forward edges a_i,b_i between each successive pair. Vanishing incidence forces x_i+y_i=z independent of i; the norm push-forward requires sums of x_i and y_i to vanish, hence nz=0, y_i=-x_i and sum x_i=0. Thus ker H_1 maps exactly to the saturated A_(n-1) lattice. The unscaled ambient energy becomes (a+b)sum x_i^2. The adjacent-difference basis yields the A Cartan matrix, determinant n by D_k=2D_(k-1)-D_(k-2). Domain all n>=2, a,b>0, both monodromies +1; not a principal Prym polarization. Independent integer determinant spot checks n=2..17 agreed; symbolic recurrence is the infinite proof.
